_readme: The national registry of permit sources. Adding a metro is a ROW here, not a new script —
that is the whole point. Each Socrata entry names the domain, the dataset, and which of its
columns hold the name, address, date, inspection type and (where present) a closing signal;
scripts/watch.py reads this and runs every one. Discover new candidates with
scripts/discover_jurisdictions.py, confirm the dataset is fresh and its fields, then add it.
Fields: id, name, platform ('socrata'), domain, resource, name_field, addr_fields (joined),
city_field, zip_field, state, date_field (ISO or YYYYMMDD), type_field?, lat_field?/lon_field?,
id_field (per-establishment dedup key), closed_field?+closed_re?, closed_bool_field?, states[].
NOT here: Santa Clara (two-table join) and LA County (bulk CSV) keep bespoke scripts because
their shape does not fit a single Socrata query; Honolulu is robots-excluded. See the README.

jurisdictions.name: New York City
jurisdictions.notes: Live feed. Pre-permit (Non-operational) inspection precedes opening.

jurisdictions.name: Chicago
jurisdictions.notes: Live. 'results' of 'Out of Business' is a closing candidate.

jurisdictions.name: Seattle / King County
jurisdictions.notes: Live. No coordinates. inspection_closed_business flags a closure.

jurisdictions.name: Austin
jurisdictions.notes: Live; address is one self-contained field (addr_full). A frontier metro — holds none of these chains yet, added to catch the first Austin arrival. NOT added: New York State (health.data.ny.gov, statewide ex-NYC) is current but its 1.4M rows time out on a name search and it holds none of our chains (their NY estate is entirely in NYC); Dallas has no current open feed (its Socrata dataset stopped Jan 2024). Both checked 23 Sep 2026.

jurisdictions.name: Montgomery County MD (DC suburbs)
jurisdictions.notes: Live (updated daily). PRODUCTIVE, not frontier: on the first run it surfaced a HEYTEA in Rockville (891-F Rockville Pike) plus two MINISO already in our census. Covers the DC suburbs (Rockville/Bethesda/Gaithersburg), high Chinese-American density. Added 23 Sep 2026.
